local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local util=require('openmw.util')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local camera=require('openmw.camera')
local frames=0
local timer=0
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 frames=frames+1
 assert(Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current>0,'Player died at log encounter')
 if frames==5 then print('Cavern logs ready') end
 local target=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x51d72))
 assert(target and target:isValid(),'Cavern logs missing')
 local center=target:getBoundingBox().center
 local p=camera.getViewTransform():apply(center)
 local x=math.max(-8192,math.min(8192,math.floor(math.atan2(p.x,-p.z)*5120+.5)))
 local y=math.max(-8192,math.min(8192,math.floor(-math.atan2(p.y,-p.z)*5120+.5)))
 print(string.format('Cavern logs aim x=%d y=%d',x,y))
 local rayEnd=camera.getViewTransform():inverse():apply(util.vector3(0,0,-150))
 local hit=nearby.castRenderingRay(camera.getPosition(),rayEnd,{{ignore=self}})
 if hit.hitObject==target then print('Cavern logs focused') end
 local inv=Actor.inventory(self)
 local healing=core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x9310)
 local other=core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x930e)
 if inv:countOf(healing)==3 and inv:countOf(other)>=1 then print('Healing chest transferred') end
end}}}}
